How does this occupation differ from electricians and industrial equipment repair?

This occupation focuses on inspection, testing, and repair of electrical equipment in power facilities such as powerhouses, substations, and in-service relays, involving high voltage and power system safety; electricians focus on installing building electrical systems and code compliance; commercial and industrial equipment repairers focus on industrial control and instrumentation circuits. subject.name: Electrical and electronics repairers, powerhouse, substation, and relay
subject.summary: Under U.S. O*NET-SOC 49-2095.00, inspect, test, repair, or maintain electrical equipment in powerhouses, substations, and in-service relays: read controlled drawings and setting sheets, test equipment and circuits with instruments, repair and replace components, check protection settings and record results, then retest and submit for confirmation by an authorized role that equipment may resume operation.
